reviews.title: Upsetting Update
reviews.text:
I re-upped on a premium membership because I love certain features on the app. I just set up how I needed it and then it was updated and my favorite features removed. 

Ive been using UNUM for a few years now and my favorite feature was the ability to switch post from the top all the way to the bottom without having to drag and get lost along the way. Now the only way to move things is to drag and drop. The other feature was being able to move things either all to the top or bottom by the feed in one click. 

Now I’ve already paid for the year and I want my money back because it no longer works. Oh and the app keeps shutting down anyways so what’s the use! 

(And I rarely write reviews. The year just started and my annoyance having to write this sent this from a 2 star down to a half star. If I had my features and this update I didn’t ask for I’d be amendable to sharing my love for the app🥹)

reviews.title: New Update = Downgrade
reviews.text:
The previous version of this app was seamless and genuinely user-friendly. I could easily swap photos within the grid, toggle between images, and visually plan my feed. It was intuitive and perfect for visual thinkers.

The current update is confusing and frustrating. That same functionality now seems locked behind “Boards,” but my board is blank, which means I’m forced to rebuild my feed from scratch. That makes no sense. It adds unnecessary steps and wastes time.

On top of that, in the main feed I can now only upload photos from the media folder, not directly from my photo library, which severely limits usability.

This update feels like a downgrade. If the original features aren’t restored, I’ll be removing the app. Judging by recent reviews, I’m far from the only user feeling this way. Please listen to your users and reconsider these changes.

reviews.title: Hate the new changes
reviews.text:
I used to absolutely love this app so much so that I got the subscription version and paid for a whole year! I just went on the app recently and they updated everything on it and all of the tools to move around the photos have disappeared and is much more difficult to navigate the app. 

The app is now very different from what is even listed on the App Store and the a lot of those tools in the photos it lists are no longer available. I’ve been using this app for six years now and those tools are set UNUM apart, but no more. 

Everything takes 10 times longer and you now have to individually select photos and can’t group select to add them to ur feed. 

You can’t quickly swap photos by clicking a button anymore, you have to individually move each and every photo around now. 

They got rid of the color grid so now you can’t see your feed based on color. 

Those are just a few of the tools that have been changed. 

I used to recommend this to all of my friends, but now I don’t even know if I can even use it. Please add those features back I didn’t pay for this 😭

It’s also so confusing that I actually posted a photo to ig through the app that I did not want to post by accident, trying to figure it out. And I am very tech savvy and not old. Not to mention I also used this app for planning the Social Media’s of the company that I work for as a marketing and Social Media manager. This has all just cost me a lot of time and frustration. As I am now trying to find another app that does exactly what this app used to do. I’ve had no luck so far. a similar app to this one is also down and no one seems to post updates on their social media accounts. Some clarity for your loyal customers that have been paying $60 or whatever the cost is per year would be nice, helpful, and appreciated.

reviews.title: Please Just Work
reviews.text:
I’ve gone back and forth with the UNUM team a few times since coming aboard. I don’t like having to troubleshoot software for the people who make it. I don’t like having to spend hours resolving and fixing and redoing work to reset permissions and feeds, etc. It all adds up. When it works, it’s fine. When it doesn’t, it’s incredibly disruptive of my jobs’ reliance on a planner app that just works. Specifically, it often is requiring me to log in again, reconnect channels through 1 of 2 ways to do so, re verify my admins on Meta’s side. It is a cyclical hellscape. And in some cases, like now, even that doesn’t work, and I am unable to see the current feed— effectively mitigating the use of any planning function.

Update: 12/31/25 — The latest update has removed key features including ‘move to feed’ for imported content in planner, and ability to add buffer/shift spaces. I don’t know what the team is doing but they’ve continued to muddy a good thing. Time to switch, unfortunately. What a waste of money.
